flawed_step: 0025 | The asserted factorization is not justified. The multiples of 1,2,...,n supplied by the preceding prefix-set argument need not be distinct elements, so their factors cannot necessarily be extracted simultaneously from the product.
assessment_summary: Steps through 0019 only show that S contains a multiple of each j. They do not establish the disjoint factor allocation required to derive the factorization in 0025 and hence divisibility by n!.
